name: uniwake
description: UniWake — Wake-on-LAN, monitoring and scheduling for college labs

scripts.test: vitest run --project root --project shared --project web --project server
scripts.test:coverage: vitest run --coverage --project root --project shared --project web --project server
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:perf && npm run check:deps && npm run check:trace
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n hub,web -c blue,green "tsx watch apps/server/src/main.ts --demo --data-dir .dev-data" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.stage: node scripts/build.ts && node scripts/fetch-node.ts && node scripts/fetch-winsw.ts
scripts.screenshots: npm run build && node --import tsx scripts/screenshots.ts
